content.short: GUI-enabled building tool for Starknet Cairo developers with Codesandbox.
content.description: Cairo Contracts Wizard provides a practical starting point for building smart contracts. It offers templates to create ERC20, ERC721, and other custom tokens, with interactive menu components that guide you as the code takes shape. The generated code can be downloaded or copied directly into existing projects, allowing quick integration across supported networks such as Starknet, Ethereum, Polygon, Polygon zkEVM, and Avalanche. Templates cover common token standards and customizable boilerplate, helping developers scaffold features efficiently.
content.meta: Cairo Contracts Wizard helps developers start building smart contracts. Discover Cairo Contracts Wizard and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
